```{python}
#| output: false
import numpy as np
import polars as pl
import requests
import xgboost as xgb
from pathlib import Path
from plotnine import (
    ggplot, aes, geom_point, geom_line, geom_col, geom_abline, geom_jitter,
    geom_histogram, labs, theme_minimal, coord_flip, facet_wrap,
)
from great_tables import GT
from IPython.display import HTML, display

ROOT = Path.cwd()
while not (ROOT / "python" / "artifacts").is_dir():
    ROOT = ROOT.parent
ART = ROOT / "python" / "artifacts"
CACHE = ROOT / "docs" / "models" / ".cache"
CACHE.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
DL = "https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/download"
def cached(tag, name):
    p = CACHE / name
    if not p.exists():
        r = requests.get(f"{DL}/{tag}/{name}", timeout=900)
        r.raise_for_status()
        p.write_bytes(r.content)
    return pl.read_parquet(p)

mp = cached("espn_cfb_model_pbp", "model_pbp_2025.parquet")
ratings = cached("cfb_ratings", "cfb_ratings_2025.parquet")

def gt_show(g):
    display(HTML(g.as_raw_html()))
```

The per-model cards in this directory are **generated** by
`cfb_model_reports` (stage `cfb_model_70_reports`) from the training
pipeline's real artifacts — they are already compiled documents, rebuilt on
every reports run, with LOSO metrics and calibration figures produced by the
same code that trains the models. This page is their **Quarto companion**: a
suite-level deep dive the generator does not own, recomputing the
leave-one-season-out evaluations from the committed out-of-fold artifacts,
attributing the boosters with TreeSHAP, and putting identified, human-readable
results tables on the published surfaces. Everything here is computed at
render time — from `python/artifacts/` (the model pipeline's output tree;
regenerate with `scripts/cfb_models.sh`) and the published releases.

## The corpus

```{python}
pf = pl.scan_parquet(ART / "pbp_full.parquet")
by_season = (
    pf.group_by("season")
    .agg(pl.len().alias("plays"), pl.col("game_id").n_unique().alias("games"),
         pl.col("EPA").mean().alias("mean_epa"))
    .sort("season").collect()
)
gt_show(
    GT(by_season.tail(10).to_pandas())
    .tab_header(title="Training corpus (python/artifacts/pbp_full.parquet) — last 10 of "
                      f"{by_season.height} seasons",
                subtitle="the exact frame the trainers read; regenerated by the model pipeline")
    .fmt_number(columns="plays", sep_mark=",", decimals=0)
    .fmt_number(columns="mean_epa", decimals=4)
)
```

## Exploratory data analysis

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "EPA per play by down — the down structure every play-level model must respect."
eda = (
    pf.select("down", "EPA").filter(pl.col("down").is_in([1, 2, 3, 4])
                                    & pl.col("EPA").is_not_null())
    .group_by("down").agg(pl.col("EPA").mean().alias("mean_epa"), pl.len().alias("n"))
    .sort("down").collect()
)
(
    ggplot(eda.to_pandas(), aes("factor(down)", "mean_epa"))
    + geom_col(fill="#2a6f97")
    + labs(x="down", y="mean EPA", title="EPA by down — full 2004–2025 corpus")
    + theme_minimal()
)
```

## LOSO evaluation, recomputed from the out-of-fold artifacts

The pipeline persists every model's leave-one-season-out out-of-fold
predictions under `python/artifacts/loso_*_oof.parquet`. Recomputing the
headline metrics from those files — rather than quoting the cards — keeps
this page honest against the artifacts themselves:

```{python}
rows = []
specs = [
    ("EP", "loso_ep_oof.parquet", "ep_pred", "realized", "mae"),
    ("WP (spread)", "loso_wp_oof.parquet", "wp_pred", "y", "brier"),
    ("WP (naive)", "loso_wp_naive_oof.parquet", "wp_pred", "y", "brier"),
    ("FG", "loso_fg_oof.parquet", "fg_pred", "made", "brier"),
    ("QBR", "loso_qbr_oof.parquet", "qbr_pred", "y", "mae"),
    ("xPass", "loso_xpass_oof.parquet", None, None, "brier"),
    ("Two-point", "loso_two_pt_oof.parquet", None, None, "brier"),
    ("Pregame WP", "loso_pgwp_oof.parquet", None, None, "brier"),
]
for name, fname, pred, y, kind in specs:
    p = ART / fname
    if not p.is_file():
        continue
    d = pl.read_parquet(p)
    cols = d.columns
    pred = pred if pred in cols else next((c for c in cols if c.endswith("_pred")), None)
    y = y if (y and y in cols) else next((c for c in cols if c in ("y", "realized", "made", "label")), None)
    if not pred or not y:
        continue
    dd = d.select(pl.col(pred).cast(pl.Float64).alias("p"),
                  pl.col(y).cast(pl.Float64).alias("t")).drop_nulls()
    metric = (float((dd["p"] - dd["t"]).abs().mean()) if kind == "mae"
              else float(((dd["p"] - dd["t"]) ** 2).mean()))
    rows.append({"model": name, "n_oof": dd.height,
                 "metric": "MAE" if kind == "mae" else "Brier", "value": metric})
gt_show(
    GT(pl.DataFrame(rows).to_pandas())
    .tab_header(title="LOSO out-of-fold metrics — recomputed at render time",
                subtitle="from python/artifacts/loso_*_oof.parquet; every prediction is from a model that never saw its season")
    .fmt_number(columns="n_oof", sep_mark=",", decimals=0)
    .fmt_number(columns="value", decimals=4)
)
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "WP LOSO reliability — pooled out-of-fold predicted WP vs realized win rate."
wp = pl.read_parquet(ART / "loso_wp_oof.parquet")
pred_c = "wp_pred" if "wp_pred" in wp.columns else next(c for c in wp.columns if c.endswith("_pred"))
y_c = "y" if "y" in wp.columns else "label"
cal = (
    wp.select(pl.col(pred_c).alias("p"), pl.col(y_c).cast(pl.Float64).alias("t"))
    .with_columns((pl.col("p") * 20).floor().clip(0, 19).alias("b"))
    .group_by("b").agg(pl.col("p").mean(), pl.col("t").mean(), pl.len().alias("n"))
    .sort("b")
)
(
    ggplot(cal.to_pandas(), aes("p", "t"))
    + geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="gray")
    + geom_point(aes(size="n"), color="#2a6f97") + geom_line(color="#2a6f97")
    + labs(x="predicted WP (LOSO out-of-fold)", y="realized win rate",
           title="Spread-WP reliability — 22 held-out seasons pooled")
    + theme_minimal()
)
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Per-season LOSO EP calibration MAE — drift check across the era span."
ep = pl.read_parquet(ART / "loso_ep_oof.parquet")
eps = (
    ep.group_by("season")
    .agg((pl.col("ep_pred") - pl.col("realized")).abs().mean().alias("cal_mae"),
         pl.len().alias("n"))
    .sort("season")
)
(
    ggplot(eps.to_pandas(), aes("season", "cal_mae"))
    + geom_line(color="#2a6f97") + geom_point(color="#2a6f97")
    + labs(x="held-out season", y="EP calibration MAE (points)",
           title="EP LOSO calibration by season")
    + theme_minimal()
)
```

## SHAP — the EP booster attributed

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "TreeSHAP (class-margin space), mean |contribution| across the 7 next-score classes; 4,000-play sample."
bst = xgb.Booster()
bst.load_model(str(ART / "ep.ubj"))
feats = bst.feature_names
sample = (
    pf.select(pl.col("start.TimeSecsRem").alias("TimeSecsRem"),
              pl.col("start.yardsToEndzone").alias("yards_to_goal"),
              "distance", "down_1", "down_2", "down_3", "down_4",
              "pos_score_diff_start")
    .drop_nulls().collect().sample(n=4000, seed=11)
)
X = sample.select(feats).to_numpy().astype(np.float32)
contribs = bst.predict(xgb.DMatrix(X, feature_names=feats), pred_contribs=True)
mean_abs = np.abs(contribs[:, :, :-1]).mean(axis=(0, 1))
sh = pl.DataFrame({"feature": feats, "mean_abs_shap": mean_abs.tolist()}).sort("mean_abs_shap", descending=True)
(
    ggplot(sh.to_pandas(), aes("reorder(feature, mean_abs_shap)", "mean_abs_shap"))
    + geom_col(fill="#2a6f97")
    + coord_flip()
    + labs(x="", y="mean |SHAP| (class-margin space)", title="EP TreeSHAP importance")
    + theme_minimal()
)
```

Field position dominates, clock second, score state third — the cfbscrapR
ordering, now attributed play-by-play rather than asserted. The multiclass
`pred_contribs` tensor is 3-D (the recorded gotcha); the chart aggregates
|contribution| across the seven class margins and is labeled accordingly.

## Results — the published surfaces, identified

```{python}
# pos_team in this frame is the ESPN team id; recover the display name from
# the home/away name columns on any row where the team appears.
mp2 = mp.with_columns(
    pl.when(pl.col("pos_team") == pl.col("homeTeamId"))
    .then(pl.col("homeTeamName")).otherwise(pl.col("awayTeamName")).alias("pos_team_name"))
teams = (
    mp2.filter(pl.col("epa").is_not_null()
               & ((pl.col("pass") == 1) | (pl.col("rush") == 1)))
    .group_by("pos_team")
    .agg(pl.col("pos_team_name").first().alias("offense"),
         pl.len().alias("plays"), pl.col("epa").mean().alias("epa_play"))
    .sort("epa_play", descending=True).head(10)
    .with_columns(
        ("<img src='https://a.espncdn.com/i/teamlogos/ncaa/500/"
         + pl.col("pos_team").cast(pl.Int64).cast(pl.Utf8) + ".png' height='36'/>").alias("logo"))
)
gt_show(
    GT(teams.select("logo", "offense", "plays", "epa_play").to_pandas())
    .tab_header(title="Top 10 offenses by EPA/play — 2025 published model_pbp")
    .fmt_markdown(columns="logo")
    .fmt_number(columns="plays", sep_mark=",", decimals=0)
    .fmt_number(columns="epa_play", decimals=3)
    .cols_label(logo="", offense="Offense", plays="Plays", epa_play="EPA/play")
)
```

```{python}
qbs = (
    mp2.filter((pl.col("pass") == 1) & pl.col("epa").is_not_null()
               & pl.col("passer_player_name").is_not_null())
    .group_by("passer_player_name")
    .agg(pl.col("pos_team_name").last().alias("team"), pl.len().alias("dropbacks"),
         pl.col("epa").mean().alias("epa_play"),
         pl.col("cpoe").drop_nulls().mean().alias("cpoe"))
    .filter(pl.col("dropbacks") >= 150)
    .sort("epa_play", descending=True).head(10)
)
gt_show(
    GT(qbs.to_pandas())
    .tab_header(title="Passer EPA/play leaders with CPOE — 2025 (min 150 dropbacks)",
                subtitle="epa and cpoe are the published model columns; ESPN ships no per-athlete id in this frame, so names identify")
    .fmt_number(columns=["epa_play", "cpoe"], decimals=3)
    .cols_label(passer_player_name="Passer", team="Team", dropbacks="Dropbacks",
                epa_play="EPA/play", cpoe="CPOE")
)
```

## Provenance & reproducibility

- **Per-model cards** (`ep.md` … `pregame_wp.md`): generated by
  `python -m cfb_model_reports` (stage `cfb_model_70_reports` /
  `scripts/cfb_models.sh 70`) from the training pipeline's artifacts — the
  cards are compiled documents already; regenerating them is part of the
  model pipeline.
- **This page** (`deepdive.qmd` → `deepdive.md`): rendered by
  `scripts/render_model_docs.sh` (Quarto → GFM, `--output-dir .` because
  this directory is also a Quarto website project). Inputs:
  `python/artifacts/` (LOSO OOF parquets, `pbp_full.parquet`, boosters —
  regenerate via `scripts/cfb_models.sh`) and the published
  `espn_cfb_model_pbp` / `cfb_ratings` releases (cached under
  `docs/models/.cache/`, gitignored).
- **Training data:** seasons 2004–2025 (the corpus table above is computed
  from the exact training frame). Models, gates and lineage:
  `models/manifest.yaml`, `models/REGISTRY.md`.
- **Forward-looking notes** live in [roadmap.md](roadmap.md) — the
  hand-authored companion the generator cannot clobber.

## Avenues for improvement & open issues

- **Per-model SHAP for the full suite** — this page attributes EP; wiring the
  same pass for WP/CP/xpass needs their engineered features
  (`spread_time`, `adj_TimeSecsRem`, …) exported into an analysis frame by
  the trainer, which is the cleaner fix than re-deriving them here.
- **Athlete ids in model_pbp** — the published frame carries passer *names*
  only; adding ESPN athlete ids would let the leader tables ship headshots
  the way the NFL/MLB docs do.
- **Known issue:** `python/artifacts/` is a build tree, not committed — a
  fresh clone must run the model pipeline before this page renders. That is
  deliberate (artifacts are large), but it makes this page's reproducibility
  contingent on the pipeline run; the cards' generator has the same property.
